subject: general
question: Which of the following is the largest bauxite producing states of India?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Odisha__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Odisha is the largest Bauxite producing state in the country. It almost produces more than half of the country’s total production. Hence, Option 2 is correct.**
 
• **Bauxite** is the principal **ore of aluminium production** and a **very important non-ferrous metal.**
 
• India is having **3896 million tonnes** of **bauxite resources** which is sufficient for both domestic and export demands.
 
• **Kalahandi** and **Koraput** is the main **bauxite belt in Odisha. **It also extends up to Andhra Pradesh.
